name: faustus-sdk
description: Minimal TypeScript client for the Faustus chat wire: sessions, turns, streaming, resume, cancellation and artifacts.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: node scripts/tsc-node10.mjs tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/rename-cjs.mjs dist/cjs
scripts.build:test: node scripts/tsc-node10.mjs tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/rename-cjs.mjs dist-test
